title: Ancient shipwreck discovered off Turkey claimed to be world's oldest | New Scientist
description: A ship that sank in the Early Bronze Age was probably carrying jars of olive oil and may have been on its way to the ancient city of Troy when it sank
author: Jo Marchant

title: We can rescue the AMOC after its collapse – but it won’t be easy | New Scientist
description: An AMOC weakened by climate change can be revived by cooling global temperatures, but we don't have the technology to remove huge quantities of CO2 and drive that cooling
author: Madeleine Cuff

title: This El Niño will bring predictable disasters, so why aren't we ready? | New Scientist
description: We know that this monster El Niño will bring floods, droughts, cyclones and wildfires, but some governments aren’t putting in the necessary resources to prepare for disaster
author: New Scientist

title: Microplastics may produce harmful molecules if they enter our blood | New Scientist
description: In a lab experiment, microplastics generated harmful molecules when exposed to the serum in blood, which may damage cells
author: Jo Marchant

title: Flightless ancient bird complicates our picture of wing evolution | New Scientist
description: Fossils of a ground-dwelling, carnivorous bird with wing anatomy similar to that of a pheasant may force a rewrite of the role of flight in the early evolution of birds
author: James Woodford

title: Giant bacteria could be living in your gut | New Scientist
description: Bacteria that are visible without a microscope are generally found in mangroves and fish, but an analysis of different species from around the world suggests they also reside in the human gut
author: Jo Marchant
